contexts.text: The Work referred to. DSS 2. DSS 10, etc. DLife 79:end. DFaith 37. DLW 282. DP 172. etc. AR 3. etc. BE 33. Char 201. CanonsNC 15.

When He cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices = that the Lord will disclose through the universal Heaven what is in the little book... I will lay open what was in the little book. In the little book were the things which are contained in the Doctrine of the New Jerusalem concerning the Lord, from beginning to end, which are the following... AR 479.
This Work, and others, are signified by the man child.
